name: Ebonlocke's Response to Solomon
summary: Lord Ello Ebonlocke sends Solomon a refusal from Darkshire. His letter rejects the plea for Night Watch aid in Redridge.

sections.title: A Bitter Refusal
sections.body: Magistrate Solomon asked Duskwood for reinforcements against the blackrock orcs after Stormwind ignored his petitions. Lord Ello Ebonlocke answers with anger and no promise of aid. He reminds Solomon that the Night Watch exists because Stormwind abandoned Darkshire when corrupting magic first gripped the woods. If its defenders leave to help Redridge, Duskwood will be left defenceless and fall to evil before the militia reaches the forest's edge.

sections.title: The Crumbling Frontier
sections.body: Solomon is shaken when the letter reaches him. The Stormwind Army has withdrawn from Westfall, and the royal guard is absent from Darkshire. The whole southern frontier has been left to decay. Solomon sees a terrible pattern in Stormwind's neglect of its outlying lands, and suspects treachery among the kingdom's highest powers.

faq.q: What is Ebonlocke's Response to Solomon?
faq.answer: Lord Ello Ebonlocke of Darkshire sends Magistrate Solomon of Lakeshire a sealed letter. He refuses to send the Night Watch to defend Redridge, saying Duskwood is barely holding back its own nightmares.

faq.q: Why won't Darkshire send help to Lakeshire?
faq.answer: Darkshire has no royal troops of its own. The Night Watch is made up of local volunteers, left to defend the region after Stormwind abandoned it. Lord Ebonlocke warns that if they march away, undead and vile creatures will overrun Darkshire before they leave the forest.

faq.q: How does Magistrate Solomon react to the letter?
faq.answer: Magistrate Solomon is shocked and disturbed. The royal guard's absence from Darkshire, alongside the army's withdrawal from Westfall, leads him to suspect foul play or treachery among Stormwind's leaders.
Lord Ello Ebonlocke, Darkshire's beleaguered mayor and leader of the Council of Darkshire, wrote the letter. He oversees the town's defence.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you can see how Stormwind's royal court has cut Redridge, Duskwood, and Westfall adrift.
